intro.value: Reykjavík Eco-Campsite sits in Laugardalur park, next to Laugardalslaug – which the campsite describes as Iceland's biggest geothermal pool – and next door to Dalur HI Hostel. It is open all year and is about 2 km from the city centre; city bus #14 stops in front. In winter (15 October – 15 April) only Area A is open, and only to motorhomes and campervans. There is no dump station on site: the campsite sends guests to the city's disposal point at Klettagarðar 14, about a 5-minute drive away.

winter.value: Open in winter, but 15 October – 15 April only Area A is open, for motorhomes and campervans only. Caravans, folding campers and trailer tents are permitted only 15 May – 15 October. Area B (tents and non-electric campers) is closed 15 October – 15 April.

electricity.value: Yes – 16A hookups on marked pitches in Area A (charged service). Tjalda.is says up to 50 vehicles can be connected at the same time in Area A.

kitchen.value: Yes – guest kitchen with stove tops, sinks and counters, plus a lounge; outdoor sinks with hot and cold water; open BBQ area (no equipment).

dump_station.value: No disposal on site. The campsite says to use Klettagarðar 14, which it calls the only wastewater station in Reykjavík, about 5 minutes' drive away, and not to empty waste in the public bathrooms. In October 2026 the campsite said it is building a new fresh-water filling station and grey-water disposal point (with construction disruption in October and November). Opening date: Unconfirmed.

laundry.value: Yes – 3 washers and 3 dryers, soap included; charged service, card-operated only.

camping_card.value: No – Reykjavík is not among the campsites in the Útilegukortið (Camping Card) 2026 list.

contact.value: info@reykjavikcampsite.is · +354 568 6944 · reykjavikcampsite.is. Reception 07:30–22:00; outside those hours, service phone +354 553 8110.

practical.value: Check-in from 13:00, check-out by 11:00. Pre-book online: you get a 4-digit access code by email that opens the gate and the facilities. Late arrival is fine if you have booked.
Maximum stay is 7 nights in any 30-day period.
Bookings are non-refundable. The campsite may move your dates within 6 months, if it has space.
Rental van with no licence plate yet? Book with 'TBA' as the plate and email the plate number later.
Generators, campfires and awnings, canopies or tents in Area A are not allowed. Quiet hours start at midnight. Pets are allowed if you clean up after them.
Groceries: Krambúðin is about a 5-minute walk away and Krónan about 15 minutes. Gas canisters: N1 is about a 10-minute walk away. There is no shop on site.
Small padlocked lockers with a power socket are provided for valuables. Luggage storage costs €1.50/hour or €10/day after the day you arrive (free until check-in on arrival day).
